About UsIskoscina
IskoScina is a food entrepreneurship founded by Grade 12 Science High School students. Its name combines “Isko” (Iskolar ng Bayan), “Sci” (Science), and “Kusina” (Kitchen). The business aims to offer innovative, healthy foods with familiar flavors, inspired by the youthfulness and camaraderie of its founders.
